programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A police investigator discovers a letter written 16 years earlier that provides clues to a woman's murder. And a firearms expert supplies the evidence that South Carolina authorities need to put a man on trial in 2002 for a murder committed in 1961.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A mother is suspected in the murders of two of her daughters when her third daughter finally convinces police to reopen two cold cases.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: With access to the San Francisco Police Department's work, including saliva samples taken from letters the infamous Zodiac Killer sent 30 years ago, we reevaluate the case of the serial killer who began terrorizing California in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In a city of eight million, landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006. Though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they spend the next nine years searching for answers.
programme.sub-title: Gone in a New York Minute

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When a 30-year-old mother fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL. Her family immediately suspects foul play. They embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Nine years after the murders of a mother and her teenage daughters, a wiretapped conversation helps police to crack the case. And the baffling murder of a Virginia woman is solved when human bones are discovered by a geologist in North Carolina.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a church deacon is found shot to death it looks like police may have stumbled upon a multi-party murder plot. And, a wife remains a key suspect in her husband's murder case for six years, until she attempts to prove her own innocence.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When 23-year-old Tonya McKinley is found brutally murdered on New Years Day 1985, a little boy is left motherless. A family must wait 35 years for advancements in forensic science to finally catch a killer using familial DNA.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: It takes nine years and the work of cutting-edge forensic toxicologists to solve the murder of a medical examiner's wife. Then, a determined Alabama sheriff reopens the case of the deaths of two babies, hoping to get their mother to confess.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Javier Macías decide ofrecerle dinero a Emiliano para que regrese a su país y deje en paz a Rosario. El mexicano perderá el control y golpeara al cínico abogado sin medir las consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Adoptando el papel de víctima, Javier Macías le confiesa a Rosario que Emiliano lo golpeo cuando él intentaba ayudarlo. Por otro lado, Emiliano decide llevar a Virginia a su horrible habitación para que salga despavorida y deje de acosarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Golpes vienen y van. Emiliano continúa dando serenatas en compañía del Coloso de Jalisco y el grupo del Maguey. El Coloso usara su ingenio para convencer a Emiliano de ir con Rosario a la universidad y darle una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario pasa por un momento bastantemente embarazoso cuando francisco le lleva una serenata al salón de clase. Mientras EL Coloso celebrar que El Mexicano le hizo caso y así en vez de ganar puntos con ella haría todo lo contrario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le pide disculpas a Rosario y le dice que recuerde que un día prometieron vivir uno junto al otro, que nunca la abandonará y luchará siempre por su amor, pero ella le dice que no la siga y que no la busque.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El coloso llega a buscar a Emiliano para burlarse más de él, pero el mexicano ya no tiene más paciencia y desata una pelea de grandes proporciones. Todos están a la expectativa del final de este encuentro.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Andres le dice a Rosario y a Leticia que la bronca con Molina y Lara, fue cosa de tragos, pero que si ellos no tienen límites, lo mejor es que ellas hablen con ellos y pongan esos límites.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Don Memo indaga para saber la verdad sobre Francisco, de donde viene, quien es en realidad, buscando darle la mejor oportunidad para que su vida tome un rumbo, pero el amor de Lara por Rosario no cederá e irá hasta las últimas consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario llega al Bar donde canta Lara para hablar con él. Lara y Rosario se dedican canciones que llegarán hasta lo más profundo de sus corazones.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: La discusión entre Rosario y Francisco no tiene límites, toman como excusas serenatas contratadas para cantarse las verdades, lo cual les traerá muchos problemas. Todo dependerá de una buena tonada para solucionar sus diferencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Finalmente la reconciliación entre Francisco y Rosario se hace realidad, después de mucha discusión y de muchas suplicas por el perdón, el amor supera todos los obstáculos hasta el punto de pedirle un favor a Molina.

programme.desc: El amor apasionado entre Rosario y Emiliano renace, dando paso al perdón y a la reconciliación. Por otra parte, La madre de Rosario no está de acuerdo que su hija le haya dado otra oportunidad al mexicano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El grupo de mariachis con Letty le dan una serenata a Emiliano en la cárcel. Todos los integrantes del grupo se despiden de Emiliano y le dejan una fotografía para que siempre los recuerde. Emiliano es deportado a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano Sanchez es llevado a la misma cárcel donde se encuentra Felipe Romero. Emiliano pide que su abogado sea Miguel Corona. Por otro lado, Rubén contrata un sicario de la cárcel para que asesine a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Ronald da la orden de matar a Emiliano para que no abra la boca. Emiliano le confiesa a Felipe toda la verdad. Por otro lado, Rosario saca las cosas de Emiliano de la pensión. La manada intenta consolar a Rosario con una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El sicario contratado por Rubén tratará de asesinar a Emiliano. Con lo que no cuenta el criminal, es que el mariachi se sabe defender muy bien. Los cabecillas de la organización deberán buscar una nueva estrategia para mantener en silencio a Emiliano

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Para evitar que Emiliano se declare inocente y la policía descubra quienes son los verdaderos culpables del lavado de dólares, los socios de Corona deciden contratar a los mariachis y en medio de la serenata, se toman fotos junto a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano es visitado por Corona y éste le muestra las fotos en que Rosario aparece junto a los cabecillas de la organización. Emiliano no tendrá otra opción que acceder a las pretensiones del abogado. Por otro lado, Rosario recibe la visa mexicana.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas revisa el interrogatorio y empieza a dudar de la culpabilidad de Emiliano. Por otro lado, Rosario no puede entrar al reclusorio por ser Emiliano un preso de alta seguridad. Rosario buscara la ayuda de la teniente Morales.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El encuentro en la cárcel entre Emiliano y Rosario resulta muy corto, y sirve para confirmar que la pareja se ama igual que antes. No obstante, el mariachi le advierte a su novia que lo mejor para ella es que no se vuelvan a ver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario regresa a Colombia y es bien recibida por todos sus compañeros. Por otro lado, el doctor Javier Macías le dice a Don Carlos que deben liquidar el bar cuanto antes para poder asumir las deudas que tiene.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los muchachos de la manada intentan encontrar la forma para salvar el bar Garibaldi y dentro de esta búsqueda Rosario descubre que el culpable de esta crisis financiera es el Doctor Macías. Por otro lado, llega el día del juicio de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la condena que tendrá que asumir Emiliano por unos crímenes que no cometió, Sigifredo y Fernando le escriben un correo electrónico anónimo al comandante Salas, comentándole que está cometiendo una gran injusticia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con dolor en sus corazones, los mariachis del bar Garibaldi se despiden. Rosario vende el traje de su papá para pagar la deuda que tiene con Javier Macías. Por otra parte, el comandante Salas decide reabrir la investigación del caso de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Han transcurrido varios meses desde el cierre del bar Garibaldi. Los integrantes de la manada no la pasan bien en sus nuevas vidas. Por otro lado, el Comandante Salas visita a Emiliano para decirle que ya sabe toda la verdad de su caso.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Las autoridades capturan a Miguel Corona y sus socios. Emiliano y Felipe recobran su libertad. Por otra parte, un empresario mexicano reabrirá el bar plaza Garibaldi.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Alejandro Villa Ruiz, el empresario que compró el bar Plaza Garibaldi, reúne a todos los integrantes del grupo de mariachis para hablarles sobre sus contratos. Además el empresario va en busca de don Carlos Malagón para proponerle que sea su socio.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano aparece por sorpresa vestido de Mariachi y con varias canciones le recuerda a Rosario que ella es la mujer de su vida. Emiliano y Rosario ahora podrán disfrutar de ese sentimiento que por las injusticias de la vida tuvieron que retener.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano otorga grandes regalos a todas aquellas personas que en su paso por Colombia lo ayudaron. Por otro lado, llega la noche esperada por todos, la velada en la que el Bar Plaza Garibaldi abrirá nuevamente sus puertas al público.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: A ritmo de ranchera, la reinauguración del Bar Plaza Garibaldi es toda una fiesta en la que Emiliano, el Coloso y Rosario deleitan al público. Terminada la reinauguración del bar, Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo y su amada viajan a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano y Rosario se preparan para presentar a sus familias y formalizar su unión en compañía de sus amigos mariachis. Lo que parecía ser la noche perfecta para esta pareja de enamorados, podría convertirse en un mal momento.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Luego de darse cuenta de su equivocación al dudar de la fidelidad de Rosario, Emiliano comienza a planear la manera de enmendar su error. Sus amigos y familiares deberán ayudar al mariachi a recuperar a la mujer con la quiere compartir su vida

Daring to be different, Warren chooses to focus on funny! Earlier this year Warren was seen on the FOX TV show “Laughs”, he's also a regular on the Bob and Tom Morning Show. More importantly, Warren has gone overseas and performed for our troops stationed in Iraq, Kuwait and Afghanistan...not once or twice, but FIVE times. His style is original, relatable and definitely funny. Don't take his word for it, see some of the funny for yourself.

programme.title: Lucas Bohn
programme.desc: LUCAS BOHN is energetic with an edge. The perfect blend of schoolboy charm and bad-boy charisma, his comedy is both smart and audacious. Known as the little guy who generates big laughs, Lucas has shared the stage with Dave Chappelle, Jimmy Fallon, and Kevin Hart. Lucas' high-energy shows and hilarious impersonations make him an instant hit with audiences of all ages. In 2013 Lucas was nominated "Comedian of the Year" by Campus Activities Magazine.

programme.title: Sean Peabody
programme.desc: He is often mistaken for the bouncer, security guard or bachelorette party stripper but rarely a comedian…until he takes the stage. With his passion for comedy and a personality that you can't help but be drawn to, Sean P takes any stage with a mic and makes the audience his own. Sean is immediately likable and will draw you in with his ability to tell stories that make you feel like you were there. Don't let his relaxed style fool you, he will come out blazing and have you laughing until your whole body hurts.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: The Journey Within - "South American Upland Slam - La Pampa
programme.desc: On day three of Mark Peterson's South America Upland Slam adventure, the guys are snowed in while waiting to head to La Pampa, where the weather promised to be much better. After a tense wait for the go-ahead to fly out, they finally touched down in La Pampa and headed straight to the field. There, the grasslands and scattered thickets provide the perfect habitat for Bushed Tinamou, known for their elusive nature and penchant for hiding among dense underbrush. Day four is dedicated to hunting these Tinamou, with Mark eager to track them in their natural habitat. On day five, their focus shifts to Pigeons, where they set up decoys along the edge of a cut cornfield. The anticipation of drawing in flocks makes for an incredible hunt and Mark can't wait to see what the day will bring.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Illinois isn't the first state you think about when it comes to waterfowl, but the Wentz Brothers have dialed in some honey holes over the years. On this episode, a slew of waterfowl experts put to the test some of the newest Winchester waterfowl ammunition during the great migration of the Mississippi Flyway in early December. We'll also head north to the shores of Kodiak Island, Alaska with Chris and Casey Keefer as they push the limits of Winchester's new Last Call Double Shot on fast-ripping sea ducks. GUESTS: Zach Wentz (Team Winchester) Nathan Robinson (Winchester Ammunition) Ryan Swaner (Winchester Repeating Arms) Chris Jennings (Ducks Unlimited) Mike Brasher (Ducks Unlimited) Scott Olmsted (American Hunter) Travis Hall (Field & Stream) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Col. Nick Nichols from Folds of Honor and Olympic skeet shooter Dania Vizzi are both proud Americans who have represented their country overseas. Col. Nichols commanded the air in the cockpit of a fighter jet for countless missions during his seven combat tours and Dania donned the stars and bars proudly on her shooting vest as an Olympian in Paris. Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
programme.desc: A tour of national treasures from the Smithsonian; the artifact that inspires the national anthem; the flag that flows over Fort McHenry when Francis Scott Key pens "The Star-Spangled Banner"; the battle for the fort and the history of the flag.

programme.title: Experiencing America: A Smithsonian Tour through American History
programme.sub-title: Presidents and Generals - Images of Leadership
programme.desc: How some of the country's greatest leaders have seen themselves and been seen by the nation; Washington's uniform, swords and portraits; notable photographs of Lincoln; the history of Eisenhower's distinctive army jacket and his presidential look.

programme.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity
programme.desc: This lecture introduces some issues essential to understanding how Christianity begins; growing away from its Jewish roots; ultimately becoming the most important religion of the civilization.

programme.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity
programme.sub-title: The Religious World of Early Christianity
programme.desc: This lecture introduces the pagan, polytheistic religions that dominate the early world; the most important Roman religion for the birth of Christianity; Judaism, the religion of Jesus and his followers.

programme.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity
programme.desc: In the first of three lectures on the birth of Christianity, Professor Ehrman examines the life of Jesus of Nazareth; referred to both outside the New Testament and within the Gospels themselves.

programme.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity
programme.sub-title: Oral and Written Traditions about Jesus
programme.desc: How four anonymous authors who live decades after Jesus record traditions that have been circulating orally over the intervening years; examining the extent to which those traditions have been modified in the retelling.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.desc: The historical trajectory of Christianity; contemporary ignorance of its past; considering the value of the historical study of Christianity; looking at the methods and role of the historian; the sources and limitations of historical knowledge.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.sub-title: The First Cultural Context - Greece and Rome
programme.desc: Investigating the culture of the Mediterranean world in which Christianity is born; the legacy of Alexander; the features of Greek politics, religion and philosophy; learning about the nature of Roman rule and imperial order in the region.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.desc: The circumstances of Jewish life in ancient Palestine and the diaspora; examining cultural and ideological factors that divide the Jews; the tensions they face between assimilation and separation; their resistance to Greek culture and Roman rule.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.sub-title: The Jesus Movement and the Birth of Christianity
programme.desc: Considering the resurrection as marking the birth of Christianity, as rooted in the claims of the first believers; assessing the contradiction between Jesus as the source of divine life and the degrading manner of his death.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.desc: Observing how Christianity's expansion happens; the broad adaptations it makes in a relatively short period; investigating the role of Paul's letters as a primary record of the convictions, culture, practices and troubles of the early Christians.

programme.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation
programme.desc: Influences in early Christianity beyond Jesus and Paul; the differences in conviction and perspective in the gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John; the four Gospels' interpretations of Jesus's role; their convergence on the nature of his character.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated, which is why most scholars find his approach illuminating.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.sub-title: Fact and Fiction in the Gospels
programme.desc: Scholars question the historical accuracy of some gospel accounts not out of hostility toward Christianity, but because of historical evidence; what this evidence is; how historians assess it.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Before the Gospels, accounts of Jesus are passed on by word of mouth; whether it is possible to move "behind" the written accounts to learn more about this original oral tradition, and perhaps even about Jesus himself as a historical person.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: In addition to the New Testament, other written sources about Jesus come down from antiquity; what these other, noncanonical Gospels are like; considering their origins and sources; how much they can reveal about what Jesus actually says and does.
